_comment: Copy this to config.json and fill in real values. config.json is gitignored.
_operator_note: 'me' = your own Saved Messages. The daemon DMs you there on errors / spend-cap / login alerts.
_clients_root_note: Per-client working dirs live here. Keep it SPACE-FREE and OUTSIDE this app folder (isolation rule).
_model_note: null = let Claude Code pick the default model. Set e.g. 'sonnet' to force a cheaper model per turn.

allowlist.note: your own test account — fill this in first

_allowlist_note: Only these people are served. Match by numeric 'id' (preferred, stable) or '@username'. Edit this file live; it is re-read on every incoming message — no restart needed. To remove a client, delete their entry.
